boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Saint Francis University
boards.description: Verified late-hour food destinations on campus and in the surrounding Loretto region; confirm hours before leaving, as locations may change them.

cards.title: Frankie's Café
cards.subtitle: JFK Student Center, 117 Evergreen Drive, Loretto
cards.notes: Head to the lower JFK Student Center when you need an on-campus food-court stop; check the day’s listed closing time before going.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus dining destination with several nights listed through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis University lists Frankie’s Café at 117 Evergreen Drive and publishes hours ending at 11 p.m. or midnight, depending on the day.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Mon/Tue/Thu/Sat to 11 p.m.; Wed/Fri/Sun to midnight. Verify before travel.

cards.title: McDonald's on Admiral Peary Highway
cards.subtitle: 4374 Admiral Peary Hwy, Ebensburg
cards.notes: Use the location page to confirm service before leaving; its posted restaurant and drive-thru schedule runs to midnight every day.
cards.short_summary: A midnight-listed Ebensburg food stop with restaurant and drive-thru service.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s lists this Ebensburg location’s restaurant and drive-thru hours as 5:30 a.m.–12:00 a.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are listed through 12:00 a.m. daily; check the location page for changes.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Admiral Peary Highway
cards.subtitle: 4482 Admiral Peary Hwy, Ebensburg
cards.notes: Plan this as a drive-thru stop and check the official locator on departure; it publishes midnight drive-thru closing every day.
cards.short_summary: An Ebensburg Taco Bell whose official listing marks it open late.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 4482 Admiral Peary Hwy drive-thru in Ebensburg as open 9 a.m.–12 a.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell, 4482 Admiral Peary Hwy, Ebensburg
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed through 12:00 a.m. daily; dine-in hours end earlier. Confirm before travel.

cards.title: Wendy's at Hills Plaza
cards.subtitle: 842 Hills Plz, Ebensburg
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s live location page before making the trip; both restaurant and drive-thru are currently posted through midnight.
cards.short_summary: A Hills Plaza location with midnight hours listed across the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 6 a.m.–12 a.m. daily for 842 Hills Plz in Ebensburg.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are listed through 12:00 a.m. daily; verify the current schedule before leaving.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on West High Street
cards.subtitle: 943 W High St, Ebensburg
cards.notes: Use the location’s carryout or delivery options for a later Friday or Saturday plan, and recheck service hours before ordering.
cards.short_summary: A pizza carryout and delivery location listed until 11 p.m. on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists restaurant hours at 943 W High St in Ebensburg until 11 p.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Pizza Hut, 943 W High St, Ebensburg
cards.access_notes: Listed to 11:00 p.m. Friday and Saturday; delivery availability and hours may vary, so verify before ordering.

cards.title: McDonald's on East 25th Avenue
cards.subtitle: 406 E 25th Ave, Altoona
cards.notes: For a later regional trip, check the store page and use the posted Friday or Saturday midnight closing as the planning limit.
cards.short_summary: An Altoona location with Friday and Saturday restaurant and drive-thru service listed to midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s lists 406 E 25th Ave in Altoona open until 12 a.m. on Friday and Saturday for both restaurant and drive-thru.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are listed to 12:00 a.m. Friday and Saturday; other nights close earlier. Verify before travel.

cards.title: McDonald's at Station Mall
cards.subtitle: 1500 9th Avenue Station Mall, Altoona
cards.notes: Check the official listing before heading out; the restaurant is posted through midnight daily, while drive-thru times vary by day.
cards.short_summary: A Station Mall restaurant location with midnight restaurant hours listed every day.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s lists restaurant hours of 5:30 a.m.–12 a.m. daily at 1500 9th Avenue Station Mall in Altoona.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant is listed through 12:00 a.m. daily; drive-thru can close earlier on some nights. Confirm before travel.

cards.title: Taco Bell on First Street
cards.subtitle: 1304 1st Street, Altoona
cards.notes: Treat this as a drive-thru or dine-in option only after checking the location page; it posts a 3 a.m. close across the week.
cards.short_summary: An Altoona Taco Bell with a notably later posted closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours of 9 a.m.–3 a.m. daily at 1304 1st Street in Altoona.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed through 3:00 a.m. daily. Check current service availability before making the trip.

cards.entity_name: Taco Bell, 516 W Plank Rd Suite 1
cards.title: Taco Bell on West Plank Road
cards.subtitle: 516 W Plank Rd Suite 1, Altoona
cards.notes: Use Taco Bell’s Altoona location listing to confirm the closing time on your day of travel before relying on this stop.
cards.short_summary: A second Altoona Taco Bell location listed as open until 3 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official Altoona location directory lists the 516 W Plank Rd Suite 1 restaurant as open until 3 a.m.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in Altoona, PA
cards.access_notes: Official city locator lists this location open until 3:00 a.m.; use its store page to confirm current hours before travel.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Travelers Road
cards.subtitle: 310 Travelers Road, East Freedom
cards.notes: Check Taco Bell’s official East Freedom directory close to departure; it identifies this one location as open until midnight.
cards.short_summary: An East Freedom drive-thru location with a midnight closing listed.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official East Freedom directory lists the 310 Travelers Road location as open until 12 a.m.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in East Freedom, PA
cards.access_notes: The official directory lists this location open until 12:00 a.m.; confirm current hours before travel.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Saint Francis spaces for studying, creating, playing, gathering, reflection, and campus involvement.

cards.title: John F. Kennedy Student Center
cards.subtitle: Campus hub for meeting, studying, performances, and student services
cards.notes: Use the central hub to meet a group, catch a performance, study, or connect with student-engagement staff before planning an event or joining an organization.
cards.short_summary: A multi-use campus gathering point with spaces for both social time and focused work.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis identifies the JFK Student Center as a central hub for meeting friends, live entertainment, food, quiet study, and student services.
cards.source_title: JFK Student Center | Saint Francis University
cards.access_notes: The university’s event listing gives the address as 117 Evergreen Drive and lists the building as open 24/7; follow campus access policies.

cards.title: JFK Multipurpose Lounge
cards.subtitle: Inside the John F. Kennedy Student Center
cards.notes: Bring a small group for a meeting or study session, or check the center’s programming before using the lounge for a presentation or gathering.
cards.short_summary: A flexible lounge set up for group meetings, studying, talks, and dances.
cards.evidence_claim: The JFK Student Center’s multipurpose lounge is designated for small or large group meetings, studying, speakers, presentations, and dances.
cards.source_title: JFK Student Center | Saint Francis University
cards.access_notes: Located within the JFK Student Center; availability can vary with scheduled events.

cards.title: DIY Craft Room
cards.subtitle: Lower level, John F. Kennedy Student Center
cards.notes: Plan a simple sign or project with the room’s listed craft supplies, then return materials neatly so the next group can use the space.
cards.short_summary: A hands-on campus room stocked for making signs and other small creative projects.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis says the JFK lower level includes a DIY Craft Room with supplies such as paint, paper, and pom poms.
cards.source_title: JFK Student Center | Saint Francis University
cards.access_notes: Located in the JFK Student Center lower level; confirm access or programming with the center.

cards.title: Luke Trotz Esports Arena
cards.subtitle: Lower level, John F. Kennedy Student Center
cards.notes: Stop in for a casual game or ask Student Engagement about esports opportunities; the university describes the arena as serving both competitive and casual gamers.
cards.short_summary: A named gaming space with equipment for campus esports and casual play.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis describes the Luke Trotz Esports Arena as featuring equipment for competitive and casual gamers.
cards.source_title: JFK Student Center | Saint Francis University
cards.access_notes: The arena is in Lower JFK; university orientation materials state it is open to students during the semester.

cards.title: Pasquerilla Library
cards.subtitle: Library and Learning Commons
cards.notes: Choose a quiet study room, open study area, computer lab, or group room based on the work you need to finish, and check library rules before settling in.
cards.short_summary: A four-floor learning commons with technology, study areas, and research resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis lists group study and seminar rooms, electronic classrooms, a computer lab, and the Archives in Pasquerilla Library.
cards.source_title: Library | Saint Francis University Policies Portal
cards.access_notes: Library services and room availability are subject to university policies and schedules.

cards.entity_name: Margaret M. Tobin Center for Archives and Special Collections
cards.title: Tobin Center for Archives and Special Collections
cards.subtitle: Inside Pasquerilla Library
cards.notes: Visit the archives to explore university records and special collections; begin with a focused research question and ask library staff how to request materials.
cards.short_summary: The library’s archive and special-collections center preserves Saint Francis records and historical collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis identifies the Margaret M. Tobin Center for Archives and Special Collections as home to University archives and records plus several special collections.
cards.source_title: Library | Saint Francis University Policies Portal
cards.access_notes: Located in Pasquerilla Library; handling and access to archival materials follow library procedures.

cards.entity_name: DiSepio Institute for Rural Health and Wellness
cards.title: DiSepio Institute for Rural Health and Wellness
cards.subtitle: Health, wellness, learning, and community services
cards.notes: Use the institute as a starting point for wellness resources or health-science learning, and contact the relevant center directly for appointments or program details.
cards.short_summary: A campus wellness and health-sciences facility that includes specialized centers and learning spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis says the DiSepio Institute houses specialized wellness centers and provides health-promotion and rehabilitation services to the university community.
cards.source_title: DiSepio Institute for Rural Health & Wellness | Saint Francis University
cards.access_notes: Services and facilities have their own eligibility and appointment requirements.

cards.title: Maurice Stokes Athletic Center
cards.subtitle: Athletics, fitness, recreation, and the Stokes Pool
cards.notes: Check the current facility schedule before heading over for recreation or a team event, and carry your university ID if campus staff request it.
cards.short_summary: A major campus athletics facility with arena, pool, gymnasium, and sports-support spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis states that the Stokes Athletic Center includes DeGol Arena, the Natatorium, auxiliary gymnasium, sports medicine, and other athletics spaces.
cards.source_title: Athletic Facilities | Saint Francis University Policies Portal
cards.access_notes: Saint Francis states the facility is open to enrolled students, faculty, staff, and retired faculty/staff; users may be asked for university ID.

cards.title: Immaculate Conception Chapel
cards.subtitle: Campus Ministry worship and prayer space
cards.notes: Visit for scheduled worship or a quiet prayer break; consult Campus Ministry’s current calendar if you are planning around a specific service or fellowship event.
cards.short_summary: The renovated campus chapel hosts worship, confession, and prayer access.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis describes the Immaculate Conception Chapel as hosting daily Mass, frequent confession, and 24/7 prayer access before the tabernacle.
cards.access_notes: Saint Francis states there is 24/7 access for prayer; scheduled liturgies and fellowship events have separate times.

cards.title: Our Lady of Lourdes Grotto
cards.subtitle: Campus Ministry outdoor reflection site
cards.notes: Take the path for a calm outdoor reflection stop, keeping the setting quiet and checking Campus Ministry information if a service is planned there.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor campus grotto intended for private prayer and reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis describes its Our Lady of Lourdes Grotto as a replica shrine whose quiet natural setting supports private prayer and reflection.
cards.access_notes: Mass and Eucharistic adoration are occasionally celebrated at the grotto; check Campus Ministry’s live schedule for events.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Free, documented places and student services on or beside the Saint Francis University campus in Loretto.

cards.entity_name: Southern Alleghenies Museum of Art, Loretto
cards.title: Browse SAMA Loretto
cards.subtitle: 112 Franciscan Way
cards.notes: Walk through the Loretto galleries during public hours and use one artwork as a conversation starter with a friend.
cards.short_summary: A free campus art-museum stop with rotating exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: SAMA states that general admission is free with no required fee; its Loretto site is on the Saint Francis University campus.
cards.access_notes: Open Wed–Sun, noon–4:30 p.m.; check the museum’s site before going because installations, holidays, maintenance, or private events may close a location.

cards.entity_name: Keirn Family World War II Museum
cards.title: Explore the Keirn WWII Museum
cards.subtitle: Library and Learning Commons
cards.notes: Take a self-guided look at Pennsylvania World War II artifacts, then compare one object or oral-history theme together.
cards.short_summary: A free, public-viewing museum inside the Library and Learning Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis University lists museum admission as free and says the collection is available for public viewing.
cards.source_title: Keirn Family World War II Museum | Saint Francis University
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are Mon–Fri, 10 a.m.–6 p.m.; self-guided weekend tours run 1–6 p.m. University holidays and summer hours affect access.

cards.title: Walk the Sunken Gardens
cards.subtitle: Mount Assisi, 105 Saint Francis Drive
cards.notes: Follow the stone paths and pause at the reflecting pools; bring a classmate for a quiet outdoor catch-up.
cards.short_summary: A free public garden with formal paths, a waterfall, and reflecting pools.
cards.evidence_claim: The Franciscan Friars’ visitor brochure says the gardens welcome all visitors free of charge.
cards.source_title: The Shrines and Sunken Gardens at Mount Assisi
cards.access_notes: The brochure lists the gardens as open to the public free of charge from sunrise to sunset, seven days a week.

cards.entity_name: Shrine of Our Lady of Fátima at Mount Assisi
cards.title: Take the shrine-and-garden loop
cards.subtitle: Mount Assisi grounds, 105 Saint Francis Drive
cards.notes: Use the paths around the shrine and gardens for a reflective walk, taking time to notice the sculptures and landscaping.
cards.short_summary: A free outdoor shrine visit on the Mount Assisi grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: The Franciscan Friars state that the shrines and gardens are open to the public free of charge from sunrise to sunset.
cards.source_title: The Shrines and Sunken Gardens at Mount Assisi
cards.access_notes: Public access is listed as sunrise to sunset daily. The Limestone Castle is visible from the grounds but is not open to the public.

cards.title: Meet for a fitness-center session
cards.subtitle: DiSepio Institute for Rural Health and Wellness
cards.notes: Choose a short shared routine using the cardio, strength, stretching, or free-weight areas, and finish with a cool-down.
cards.short_summary: Student fitness-center access is included in tuition.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis University says student membership is included in University tuition.
cards.access_notes: For enrolled students; the university lists Mon–Thu 6 a.m.–10 p.m., Fri 6 a.m.–9 p.m., and weekend 10 a.m.–9 p.m., with separate summer hours.

cards.title: Try a group exercise class
cards.subtitle: DiSepio Fitness Center
cards.notes: Check the current class list, arrive together, and pick a session that fits your comfort level and schedule.
cards.short_summary: Instructor-led fitness classes are free to students.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis University states that group exercise classes are always free to members and students.
cards.access_notes: Classes are first-come, first-served and the schedule varies throughout the year; review the current events list before heading over.

cards.title: Book a Writing Center session
cards.subtitle: Library and Learning Commons, second floor
cards.notes: Bring a draft or idea and use a one-to-one consultation to talk through structure, citations, or a next revision step.
cards.short_summary: Free writing support for SFU students, available face-to-face or online.
cards.evidence_claim: The Writing Center says its one-to-one consultations are free to all SFU students.
cards.access_notes: For SFU students. The page describes face-to-face tutoring in the Library and Learning Commons and online appointments; confirm the active semester schedule.

cards.title: Get a laptop issue checked
cards.subtitle: Library and Learning Commons
cards.notes: If you opted into the laptop program, bring a device problem to the on-site repair team and ask about a temporary laptop if needed.
cards.short_summary: On-site repairs are free for students enrolled in the laptop program.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis University says it handles repairs free of charge for students who opted into the laptop program.
cards.access_notes: Available only to students who opted into the SFU Laptop Program; confirm help-desk availability before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Saint Francis University Individual Daily Visit
cards.title: Join an individual campus visit
cards.subtitle: Admissions Welcome Center
cards.notes: Register for a weekday visit to walk campus with an admissions guide and meet an enrollment advisor at your own pace.
cards.short_summary: A weekday campus visit that includes a complimentary lunch.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis University describes its individual daily visit as a half-day campus experience with a complimentary lunch.
cards.access_notes: Designed for prospective first-year, transfer, and graduate students; register ahead and choose a morning or afternoon Monday–Friday slot.

cards.title: Join a R.O.C.K. chemistry activity
cards.subtitle: Science Outreach Center program
cards.notes: If you are with an eligible K–12 group, try the hands-on experiments and equipment provided through the outreach program.
cards.short_summary: A Saint Francis student-led chemistry outreach activity provided free of charge.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis University says R.O.C.K. lets K–12 participants conduct experiments and try program equipment free of charge.
cards.access_notes: For local K–12 schools and youth organizations through the outreach program; participation depends on an arranged program visit.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct, university-documented places for quiet work, group sessions, academic help, or study breaks at Saint Francis University.

cards.entity_name: Library & Learning Commons Quiet Study Rooms
cards.title: Library & Learning Commons Quiet Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Library & Learning Commons, Saint Francis University
cards.notes: Start here when you need a low-distraction setting. The university’s library tour specifically identifies quiet study rooms among the spaces students can explore.
cards.short_summary: Dedicated quiet rooms within the Library & Learning Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: A Saint Francis University library tour describes quiet study rooms in the Library & Learning Commons.
cards.source_title: Student Support Services: Get to the SFU Library
cards.access_notes: The cited session was for students; current room availability and any booking rules are not stated on the source.

cards.entity_name: Library & Learning Commons Open Study Areas
cards.title: Library & Learning Commons Open Study Areas
cards.subtitle: Library & Learning Commons, Saint Francis University
cards.notes: Use the library’s open study areas for individual work with a little ambient activity. Pair a work block with research help if you need it.
cards.short_summary: Shared open study areas in the campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: A Saint Francis University library tour identifies open study areas in the Library & Learning Commons.
cards.source_title: Student Support Services: Get to the SFU Library
cards.access_notes: The cited session was for students; current seating availability is not stated on the source.

cards.entity_name: Library & Learning Commons Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Library & Learning Commons Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Library & Learning Commons, Saint Francis University
cards.notes: Bring a project team or course partner to a group study room. Check with library staff before relying on a room for a scheduled meeting.
cards.short_summary: Library rooms intended for group work and discussion.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis University’s library policy lists group study rooms among Library facilities.
cards.access_notes: The policy confirms the rooms but does not state reservation procedures; contact the Library & Learning Commons for current use rules.

cards.title: Library & Learning Commons Seminar Rooms
cards.subtitle: Library & Learning Commons, Saint Francis University
cards.notes: Consider a seminar room for a focused small-group session. Ask library staff about scheduling before planning a presentation or extended collaboration.
cards.short_summary: Seminar-capable rooms in the university library.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis University’s library policy lists group study and seminar rooms among Library facilities.
cards.access_notes: The policy confirms seminar rooms but does not publish current reservation or access requirements.

cards.entity_name: Library & Learning Commons Public Computer Lab
cards.title: Library & Learning Commons Public Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Library & Learning Commons, Saint Francis University
cards.notes: Choose the public computer lab when your work needs a campus workstation. Bring files in a cloud account or portable storage for a smoother session.
cards.short_summary: A library-based computer workspace.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis University’s library policy lists a public computer lab among Library facilities.
cards.access_notes: The policy confirms the lab; equipment availability and any login requirements are not stated on the source.

cards.title: Tutoring Center
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Library & Learning Commons
cards.notes: Book a one-to-one or group tutoring session when course material has stalled. Walk-ins are also accepted on a first-come, first-served basis.
cards.short_summary: Peer-tutoring workspace for individual or group academic support.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tutoring Center offers one-to-one or group sessions on the second floor of the Library & Learning Commons, with appointments preferred and walk-ins welcome.
cards.access_notes: For Saint Francis University students. Appointments are preferred; walk-ins are first-come, first-served.

cards.title: Writing Center
cards.subtitle: First floor, Library & Learning Commons
cards.notes: Bring a draft, outline, or research question for a one-to-one writing consultation. Appointments are preferred, with walk-ins handled as space permits.
cards.short_summary: Consultation space for developing coursework writing.
cards.evidence_claim: The Writing Center provides one-to-one consultations in the first-floor Library and Learning Commons, with appointments preferred and walk-ins welcome.
cards.access_notes: For Saint Francis University students. Appointments are preferred; walk-ins are first-come, first-served.

cards.title: JFK Student Center Multipurpose Lounge
cards.subtitle: John F. Kennedy Student Center
cards.notes: Set up for a study meeting or presentation practice in the multipurpose lounge. Its documented uses include small and large group meetings and studying.
cards.short_summary: Flexible lounge space for collaborative study.
cards.evidence_claim: The JFK Student Center multipurpose lounge is used for small or large group meetings, studying, speakers, and presentations.
cards.access_notes: Located in the JFK Student Center; the source does not state reservation requirements or current availability.

cards.title: Commuter Hub
cards.subtitle: First floor, Padua Hall
cards.notes: Use the tables for a between-class work session, then store materials in the nearby lockers if eligible. The hub also has lounge seating and appliances.
cards.short_summary: Padua Hall hub with tables for studying.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis University lists the Commuter Hub on Padua Hall’s first floor with tables for studying, lockers, lounge seating, and appliances.
cards.access_notes: Presented by the university as a commuter resource; confirm eligibility and locker use with the Center for Student Engagement.

cards.title: Adamucci Café Study Tables
cards.subtitle: Bottom level, Schwab Hall
cards.notes: Choose the study tables at Adamucci Café for a work session near coffee and snacks. Keep the visit focused on its documented table workspace.
cards.short_summary: Study tables in Schwab Hall’s café area.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis University identifies Adamucci Café on Schwab Hall’s bottom level as having coffee, snacks, and study tables.
cards.access_notes: Located on the bottom level of Schwab Hall. The source does not state whether a purchase is needed to use tables or current operating hours.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named, photo-documentable destinations on the campus-adjacent St. Mary Street and Mount Assisi corridors in Loretto.

cards.title: Biddle's Brewing Coffeehouse
cards.subtitle: St. Mary Street corridor, Loretto
cards.notes: Walk the St. Mary Street corridor to photograph the coffeehouse storefront at 268 St. Mary Street; the university identifies coffee, lattes, and bakery items.
cards.short_summary: A named coffeehouse and bakery on Loretto’s main nearby corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis University identifies Biddle's Brewing Coffeehouse at 268 St. Mary Street and notes that it serves coffee, lattes, and bakery items.
cards.access_notes: Commercial venue; confirm current service details directly before visiting.

cards.title: Smithmyer's Superette
cards.subtitle: St. Mary Street corridor, Loretto
cards.notes: Use the St. Mary Street walk for a grocery stop at 163 St. Mary Street; the university describes an in-store meat department and bakery.
cards.short_summary: A documented family-operated grocery destination near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis University lists Smithmyer's Superette in Loretto and describes it as family owned and operated with an in-store meat department and bakery.
cards.access_notes: Commercial venue; confirm current store access and offerings directly before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Basilica of St. Michael the Archangel
cards.title: Basilica of St. Michael the Archangel
cards.subtitle: St. Mary Street corridor, Loretto
cards.notes: Pause along St. Mary Street to photograph the Basilica exterior and pair it with the nearby Gallitzin memorial sites documented by the regional visitor bureau.
cards.short_summary: A named religious landmark anchoring the Loretto corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Johnstown identifies the Shrine of Our Lady of the Alleghenies as located between the Basilica of St. Michael the Archangel and Prince Gallitzin Chapel House.
cards.source_title: The Shrine Of Our Lady Of The Alleghenies | Visit Johnstown
cards.access_notes: Religious site; observe posted visitor guidance and service-related access.

cards.entity_name: The Shrine of Our Lady of the Alleghenies
cards.title: The Shrine of Our Lady of the Alleghenies
cards.subtitle: St. Mary Street corridor, Loretto
cards.notes: Make this a short St. Mary Street landmark stop: the visitor bureau places the shrine between the Basilica and Prince Gallitzin Chapel House.
cards.short_summary: A named shrine connecting three historic Loretto destinations.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Johnstown lists The Shrine of Our Lady of the Alleghenies at 321 Saint Mary's Street, between the Basilica and Prince Gallitzin Chapel House.
cards.source_title: The Shrine Of Our Lady Of The Alleghenies | Visit Johnstown
cards.access_notes: Outdoor religious landmark; respect the site and any posted access guidance.

cards.entity_name: Servant of God Demetrius Gallitzin's Tomb
cards.title: Servant of God Demetrius Gallitzin's Tomb
cards.subtitle: St. Mary Street corridor, Loretto
cards.notes: Plan a seasonal St. Mary Street stop at the tomb beside the Basilica; the regional visitor bureau says this underground crypt is open April through October.
cards.short_summary: A named crypt beside the Basilica with a published seasonal window.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Johnstown lists Servant of God Demetrius Gallitzin's Tomb at 321 Saint Mary's Street, adjacent to the Basilica, and states it is open April through October.
cards.source_title: Servant Of God Demetrius Gallitzin’s Tomb | Visit Johnstown
cards.access_notes: The published access period is April through October; verify conditions before making a special trip.

cards.title: Prince Gallitzin Chapel House
cards.subtitle: St. Mary Street corridor, Loretto
cards.notes: At 357 St. Mary Street, arrange a tour appointment to see the chapel house’s sanctuary, artifacts, and the residential area once occupied by Gallitzin.
cards.short_summary: A named historic chapel house with appointment-based tours.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Johnstown lists Prince Gallitzin Chapel House at 357 Saint Mary's Street, describes its sanctuary and artifacts, and says tours are available by appointment.
cards.source_title: Prince Gallitzin Chapel House | Visit Johnstown
cards.access_notes: Tours are available by appointment, according to the listed visitor information.

cards.title: Captain Michael McGuire Memorial Park
cards.subtitle: Metz Road corridor beside campus, Loretto
cards.notes: Follow Metz Road beside campus to this named community park; it was created as a multi-use space for health, fitness, and Loretto heritage.
cards.short_summary: A campus-adjacent public park with recreation and heritage purposes.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis University reports that Captain Michael McGuire Memorial Park is on Metz Road adjacent to campus and describes it as a multi-use community facility.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor community park; use public paths and observe posted rules.

cards.title: Mount Assisi Sunken Gardens
cards.subtitle: Saint Francis Drive corridor, Loretto
cards.notes: Take the Saint Francis Drive spur to the gardens at Mount Assisi and walk the landscaped grounds; the Friars say the shrines are open sunrise to sunset daily.
cards.short_summary: A named garden destination on the Mount Assisi section of the corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Franciscan Friars list the Shrines and Sunken Gardens at Mount Assisi at 105 Saint Francis Drive and state that the shrines are open to the public from sunrise to sunset seven days a week.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public sunrise to sunset seven days a week; observe site guidance.

cards.entity_name: Shrine of Our Lady of Fatima
cards.title: Shrine of Our Lady of Fatima
cards.subtitle: Saint Francis Drive corridor, Mount Assisi
cards.notes: Use the Mount Assisi garden path to locate this named shrine; its official page places it in the Sunken Gardens and lists sunrise-to-sunset access.
cards.short_summary: A named shrine within the documented Mount Assisi garden grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: The Franciscan Friars state that the Shrine of Our Lady of Fatima is located in Mount Assisi's Sunken Gardens at 105 Saint Francis Drive and is open sunrise to sunset.
cards.access_notes: The shrine is listed as open sunrise to sunset; observe religious-site guidance.

cards.entity_name: Stations of the Cross at Mount Assisi
cards.title: Stations of the Cross at Mount Assisi
cards.subtitle: Saint Francis Drive corridor, Mount Assisi
cards.notes: Walk the named Stations along the Mount Assisi grounds rather than entering restricted areas; the Friars identify them as lining the garden walkway.
cards.short_summary: A documented outdoor devotional route within the Mount Assisi grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: The Franciscan Friars' tourism brochure states that the Stations of the Cross line the walkway at the Shrines and Sunken Gardens, which are open free of charge from sunrise to sunset daily.
cards.source_title: The Shrines and Sunken Gardens at Mount Assisi Tourism Brochure
cards.access_notes: The brochure states the grounds are open free of charge from sunrise to sunset, seven days a week.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Documented Saint Francis University rituals, recurring observances, and long-running campus events in Loretto.

cards.entity_name: Saint Francis University Mock National Convention
cards.title: Mock National Convention
cards.subtitle: A four-year campus political convention
cards.notes: Follow the student-created convention tradition, held every four years for the party not holding the presidency; review the archival history before the next cycle.
cards.short_summary: Since 1960, students have staged a convention that blends civic learning with campus spectacle.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis says its Mock National Convention began in 1960, occurs every four years, and traditionally represents the party not holding the presidency.
cards.source_title: History of Mock Conventions at Saint Francis University
cards.access_notes: Dates and participation vary by convention cycle; consult university announcements.

cards.title: Mr. and Ms. Frankie Awards
cards.subtitle: Senior honors presented at the President’s Awards Convocation
cards.notes: Watch for the senior recognition during the spring convocation, then read the student newspaper’s history connecting the awards to generations of Loretto students.
cards.short_summary: The paired student awards preserve a campus link to the 1930s and 1960s.
cards.evidence_claim: The Troubadour reports that Mr. Frankie began in 1936, Ms. Frankie began in 1962, and both are presented annually at the President’s Awards Convocation.
cards.source_title: Mr. and Ms. Frankie Awards Have Rich History
cards.access_notes: Award recipients are selected annually; attendance details are announced with the convocation.

cards.title: Open the academic year with the Holy Spirit
cards.subtitle: Campus Mall, first week of classes
cards.notes: Join the campus community on the Campus Mall for the opening liturgy, which asks for wisdom, strength, and unity in the academic year ahead.
cards.short_summary: A 12-year Saint Francis opening-of-year prayer tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis describes the Mass of the Holy Spirit as a 12-year university tradition held to open the academic year.
cards.access_notes: The university has said this observance occurs during the first week of classes; confirm the current event listing.

cards.title: Remember the six founding friars
cards.subtitle: Annual Saint Francis founders observance
cards.notes: Look for the fall Founders Day gathering, which centers the six Franciscan founders and gives the community a chance to recognize university benefactors.
cards.short_summary: A recurring remembrance of the six friars who founded the institution in Loretto.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis’ alumni archive calls Founders Day an annual tradition commemorating the university’s six Franciscan founders and thanking benefactors.
cards.access_notes: The 2025 observance was held in October; verify the current year’s invitation and location.

cards.title: President’s Awards Convocation
cards.subtitle: Maurice Stokes Athletics Center
cards.notes: Attend the spring convocation to see Saint Francis recognize student achievement alongside faculty and staff commitment to the university’s mission.
cards.short_summary: A formal annual campus gathering focused on achievement, leadership, service, and mission.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis identifies the President’s Awards Convocation as an annual tradition recognizing student, faculty, and staff achievement.
cards.access_notes: The 2026 event was scheduled for the Maurice Stokes Athletics Center; check the calendar for the next convocation.

cards.title: March on the Mountain
cards.subtitle: Prayer walk around the Campus Mall
cards.notes: If the observance is offered, join the Campus Mall walk respectfully; participants circle the mall in prayer as part of the university’s January gathering.
cards.short_summary: A named annual Campus Mall prayer walk with a distinctly Loretto setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis’ 2025 archive states that the university held its 12th annual March on the Mountain, with participants circling the Campus Mall in prayer.
cards.access_notes: The archive records a January 2025 event; confirm whether and when a future observance is scheduled.

cards.title: STEAM Day
cards.subtitle: School of STEAM outreach day
cards.notes: Volunteer for or observe hands-on sessions led by students, faculty, alumni, and professionals when regional high-school visitors come to campus.
cards.short_summary: A student-originated annual outreach event that has grown from Science Day to STEAM Day.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis reports that students started Science Day in 1994 and that the annual event evolved into STEAM Day.
cards.source_title: STEAM Day 2024: A Tradition of Career Exploration Continues
cards.access_notes: Designed primarily for visiting high-school students; participation roles and scheduling are determined by the School of STEAM.

cards.title: R.O.C.K. chemistry outreach
cards.subtitle: Rural Outreach Chemistry for Kids
cards.notes: Seek volunteer or presentation opportunities through the science program; the long-running outreach connects Saint Francis chemistry with younger learners in the region.
cards.short_summary: A Saint Francis community-science program operating since 1995.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis’ 2025 archive says the Rural Outreach Chemistry for Kids program has served the community since 1995.
cards.access_notes: This is an outreach program rather than an open drop-in event; contact the university for current involvement options.

cards.title: Red Mass for Law Day
cards.subtitle: Immaculate Conception Chapel
cards.notes: Attend the Law Day liturgy at the chapel when announced; the event gathers legal and civic communities to reflect on justice and professional responsibility.
cards.short_summary: An annual Law Day observance in Saint Francis’ Franciscan setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis describes its Red Mass as an annual, longstanding university tradition connected to Law Day and the legal profession.
cards.source_title: Celebrating Law Day 2026: The Rule of Law and the American Dream
cards.access_notes: The 2026 Mass was scheduled at Immaculate Conception Chapel; future dates are announced by the university.

cards.entity_name: Lourdes Army Grotto Service Project and Twilight Mass
cards.title: Lourdes Army Grotto Day
cards.subtitle: Our Lady of Lourdes Grotto during Alumni Weekend
cards.notes: Join the listed Grotto service project or the evening Twilight Mass during Alumni Weekend, following current registration or participation guidance from alumni engagement.
cards.short_summary: A service-and-worship pairing that returns alumni to the Our Lady of Lourdes Grotto.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis’ 2026 Alumni Weekend schedule includes a Lourdes Army service project to prepare the grotto for the annual Twilight Mass.
cards.access_notes: Listed within Alumni Weekend, July 23–26, 2026; consult the current schedule for registration and participation details.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Saint Francis University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key, under-21-safe sequence for learning the Loretto campus, connecting with campus life, and ending the weekend with a reflective walk.

cards.title: Start with New Student Orientation
cards.subtitle: Friday morning · campus welcome
cards.notes: Use the orientation sessions to get your bearings, then note the buildings and services you want to revisit once the scheduled program ends.
cards.short_summary: A structured starting point for meeting the campus and planning the rest of the weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis lists New Student Orientation and says Orientation Counselors host guided academic-building tours and activities for new students.
cards.access_notes: Orientation programming is scheduled by the university; consult the current orientation page for details.

cards.title: Get oriented at JFK Student Center
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · campus hub
cards.notes: Stop by the Student Center to locate the Center for Student Engagement and take a quick lap of the lower-level student spaces.
cards.short_summary: A practical hub for student engagement, club space, food, and campus services.
cards.evidence_claim: The Center for Student Engagement says its office is in JFK Student Center, and the university identifies lower-level club meeting space, a bookstore, DIY room, esports arena, and Frankie’s there.
cards.source_title: JFK Student Center | Saint Francis University
cards.access_notes: Visit during building operations; specific space availability may vary with events and reservations.

cards.title: Have a first campus meal at Torvian
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · dining hall
cards.notes: Make this a simple meal stop: check the current menu or service window, then use the walk back to notice nearby campus landmarks.
cards.short_summary: The university’s main dining hall, with meal-plan and pay-at-door options described for orientation.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis identifies Torvian as an on-campus dining hall, and its 2026 orientation page lists lunch service there and payment at the door.
cards.access_notes: Dining service and payment options can change; check the university’s current dining information before going.

cards.title: Choose a study spot in the Library and Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · academic reset
cards.notes: Meet a new classmate for a short planning session, identify the floors you will use, and save the library location for future group work.
cards.short_summary: A named campus study destination used for group sessions and academic support.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis Residence Life specifically suggests meeting classmates in the Library and Learning Commons for a group study session.
cards.access_notes: Check library access and service hours before visiting.

cards.title: Make something in the D.I.Y. Room
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · lower-level JFK
cards.notes: Bring a small project idea or browse the supplies, then use the room as a calm way to take a break between welcome-week activities.
cards.short_summary: A craft-focused room in JFK Student Center with supplies for creative projects.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis identifies a DIY craft room filled with supplies in the lower level of JFK Student Center.
cards.source_title: JFK Student Center | Saint Francis University
cards.access_notes: Confirm room availability and any material-use guidance with the Student Center.

cards.title: See the Luke Trotz Esports Arena
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · lower-level JFK
cards.notes: Drop in to locate the arena and ask about current student access or programming, especially if gaming is a way you like to meet people.
cards.short_summary: A named esports facility located in the lower level of JFK Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis describes the Luke Trotz Esports Arena as a cornerstone of the lower-level JFK Student Center.
cards.source_title: Esports at SFU | Saint Francis University
cards.access_notes: Ask the Esports program about current access, equipment, and event availability.

cards.title: Find DeGol Arena before game day
cards.subtitle: Saturday late afternoon · Stokes Athletic Center
cards.notes: Walk through the Stokes Athletics Center area and save the arena location, so attending a future Red Flash event feels straightforward.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing Red Flash athletics venue inside Maurice Stokes Athletics Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis says DeGol Arena in the Maurice Stokes Athletics Center has been home to Red Flash Athletics for more than 50 years.
cards.access_notes: Event entry, seating, and facility access depend on the athletics schedule and venue policies.

cards.title: Take the paved walk to the Grotto
cards.subtitle: Sunday morning · outdoor reflection
cards.notes: Follow the paved path across from Cafe Gubbio, pause to view the shrine and Stations of the Cross, and keep the visit quiet and respectful.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor spiritual space with a Lourdes replica, Pietà, Nativity scene, and Stations of the Cross.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis says the Grotto includes a replica of Our Lady of Lourdes, the Pietà, a Nativity scene, and Stations of the Cross, reached by a paved path.
cards.access_notes: Use the paved path described by the university and respect the site’s reflective purpose.

cards.title: Step into Immaculate Conception Chapel
cards.subtitle: Sunday morning · campus chapel
cards.notes: If it fits your interests, visit during a listed service or simply spend a few quiet minutes looking at the restored chapel before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A campus chapel with daily, weekend, and holy-day Masses that welcomes students and local residents.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis states that Immaculate Conception Chapel holds daily, weekend, and holy-day Masses and welcomes students, teachers, and local residents.
cards.source_title: Immaculate Conception Chapel | Saint Francis University
cards.access_notes: The university publishes a Mass and prayer schedule; consult it for current service times.

cards.title: Close with a walk through Schwab Gardens
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · Mount Assisi Friary
cards.notes: Take an unhurried public-viewing walk through the gardens, then use the setting as a final landmark to remember from your first weekend.
cards.short_summary: Italian Renaissance-style gardens at the former Charles M. Schwab estate, now Mount Assisi Friary.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis says Schwab Gardens at Mount Assisi Friary are open for public viewing and were designed by Charles Wellford Leavitt Jr.
cards.access_notes: The university describes the gardens as open for public viewing; observe posted conditions while visiting.
